event_chain.summary: Full film posted to public product page

summary: Around August 19, 2026, two days before its theatrical release, Amazon mistakenly posted the full finished Lionsgate film Mutiny to its Prime Video product page, where trailers normally appear, because of a backend error. The file stayed publicly accessible for hours before anyone caught it and circulated widely. The film earned about $16 million worldwide against a budget around $50 million, and distributors were reportedly seeking compensation from Amazon.
